description: This file defines the EmailConfigurationModel class in PHP, which is used to serialize and normalize email configuration data for the OrangeHRM system. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for serialization. The class encapsulates email configuration properties like SMTP host, port, username, and security options.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing email configuration data in the OrangeHRM API context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmailConfigurationModel with an EmailConfiguration entity and sets up filters and attribute names for serialization.
